name: Slingshot
design_intent: ORBIT circuit 2 of 3. Lesson: USE THE WELL, DON'T FIGHT IT. A black-hole well (bumper core body_r 100 - never lethal in trials, same ruling as the Singularity arena; field r 1200, g 1100) sits between the start pad (far left, just outside the field edge) and a goal ring high on the far right at the field's opposite rim. The straight line to the goal passes the core: dive in, let the pull whip you around the bumper core (or ricochet off it - it IS a bumper), and release your boost on the outswing. Fuel math: the crossing is ~2400px; one tank flies ~2660px, and the start pad refunds on retry bounces, so a failed sling is a cheap retry (fall out the bottom of the field -> global down -> respawn). The faint field ring shows exactly where the pull begins.
hint: DIVE IN — LET THE HOLE SLING YOU ACROSS
